summary: Verified all 5 flows from the review request on the Expo web preview (mobile viewport 390x844). ALL PASS. (1) Legacy v1 single-project import: /tmp/legacy_test.aufmass imported successfully, 'Legacy Testprojekt (Import)' appears on home list, Fotos tab shows counter '1' confirming the embedded photo was persisted. (2) Legacy v1 multi-project import: /tmp/legacy_multi.aufmass with 2 projects imported, both 'Multi A (Import)' and 'Multi B (Import)' appear on home, no auto-navigation (user remained on home as expected). (3) Multi-select export of 2 projects produced blob download 'Projekte_2026-10-10_2.aufmass' (949 bytes), first line is header '{"format":"aufmass-stream","version":"2.0","projectCount":2,...}' and body contains exactly 2 lines with '"type":"project"'. (4) WEB SHARE GUARD REGRESSION FIXED/VERIFIED: Single-project 'Export Project' from project detail now downloads 'Multi_A__Import_.aufmass' (525 bytes) with ZERO console errors — no 'UnavailabilityError: navigator.share' and no export-error alert. (5) Roundtrip of multi-export: re-imported the downloaded Projekte_*.aufmass → both projects appeared again with additional '(Import)' suffix ('Multi A (Import) (Import)' etc.), proving the v2 streaming path handles multi-project NDJSON files on both export and import. No business-logic or integration bugs found. Only pre-existing noisy deprecation warnings ('shadow*' and 'pointerEvents') remain and were already reported in iteration_27.

critical_code_review_comments: utils/projectTransfer.ts: both export paths (web Blob + native streamed FileHandle) share writeProjectLines() + processRecord() logic — good; multi-project filename pattern Projekte_<YYYY-MM-DD>_<count>.aufmass matches spec; legacy v1 payload with projects[] array now routes through importLegacyPayload() correctly.
app/projects/[id].tsx:1849 and app/index.tsx:288 — Platform.OS !== 'web' guard around Sharing.shareAsync is in place; verified via E2E that web export produces no UnavailabilityError.
After legacy single-project import the app auto-navigates to the new project detail (intended UX per prompt). After multi-project import the user stays on home — behaviour matches the spec.

success_rate.frontend: 5/5 explicit flows PASS; 0 console errors during export; v2 header validated as JSON; multi-project roundtrip verified

seed_data_creation: Created /tmp/legacy_test.aufmass (v1 single-project with embedded 1x1 PNG photo) and /tmp/legacy_multi.aufmass (v1 multi-project with 2 bundles). Imported them into AsyncStorage during the test; data is local to the browser context used during the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each mcp_browser_automation call creates a FRESH browser context — localStorage/AsyncStorage does NOT persist across tool invocations. Any flow that needs seeded data must perform the seeding in the SAME tool call. Pro is unlocked by setting localStorage key `aufmassprofi_pro_unlocked='true'` + `aufmassprofi_disclaimer_accepted='true'` and reloading. Disclaimer still shows on first visit even with the flag set — the inner ScrollView must be scrolled to the bottom before the checkbox becomes enabled; checkbox is to the LEFT of the label 'Ich habe den Haftungsausschluss gelesen...' (click ~15px left of the label's bounding box). After legacy v1 single-project import, the app navigates INTO the imported project detail — go back to '/' via page.goto() before chaining more imports.
rca_of_issue: No new issues. The two issues reported in iteration_27 (navigator.share on web + updateFeatures()) are both fixed: (a) exportSelectedProjects in app/index.tsx:288 and exportProjectFile in app/projects/[id].tsx:1849 both guard Sharing.shareAsync with Platform.OS !== 'web', so the Blob download path on web no longer triggers the UnavailabilityError or the error-alert cascade; verified by capturing 0 console errors during single + multi exports. (b) updateFeatures() is called after loadProStatus() so Import/Select buttons appear reliably on home when Pro is unlocked.
